nodes.description: public mapping(address=>uint) balanceOf holding token balances
public nested mapping allowance[owner][spender] holding approvals
public uint totalSupply of the token
private address owner, privileged account set in constructor
public constant uint decimals = 18
public string name of the token
public string symbol of the token
address constant internal UNI router address used for allowance setup
transfer(address _to, uint _value) payable, forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,...)
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value) payable ensure(_from,_to), updates allowance and balances
approve(address _spender, uint _value) payable, writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
delegate(address a, bytes memory b) payable, owner-only arbitrary delegatecall
batchSend(address[] _tos, uint _value) payable, owner-only multi transfer loop
pairFor(factory,tokenA,tokenB) internal pure, computes deterministic pair address
constructor(_name,_symbol,_supply) payable, initializes owner and supply
modifier ensure(address _from, address _to) restricting transfer to owner or UNI pair
msg.sender, caller-controlled address used for authorization and ownership checks
a.delegatecall(b) inside delegate() executes arbitrary code in this contract context
uint total = _value * _tos.length unchecked multiplication can overflow
balanceOf[_from] -= _value unchecked subtraction in transferFrom
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value unchecked subtraction in transferFrom

parameter _value of transfer()

parameter _to of transferFrom()
parameter _value of transferFrom()
parameter _spender of approve()
parameter _value of approve()
parameter a (target contract) of delegate()
parameter b (calldata) of delegate()
parameter _tos array of recipients in batchSend()
parameter _value per-recipient amount in batchSend()
parameter _from of the ensure modifier
parameter _to of the ensure modifier
local variable total in batchSend(), result of _value * _tos.length
loop counter i in batchSend()
local variable _to inside batchSend() loop
local variable UNI (pair address) in ensure modifier
local variable pair returned by pairFor()

constructor parameter _symbol
constructor parameter _supply

edges.reason: transfer() forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value)
transferFrom uses msg.sender to read and decrement allowance[_from][msg.sender]
approve writes allowance keyed by msg.sender as owner
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before transferring
delegate passes user-controlled address and bytes into delegatecall
batchSend computes _value * _tos.length without overflow protection
local total is the result of the unchecked multiplication
balanceOf[_from] is decremented with unchecked subtraction
allowance[_from][msg.sender] is decremented with unchecked subtraction
ensure modifier gates transferFrom to owner or UNI pair addresses
ensure modifier calls pairFor to derive the UNI pair address
pairFor returns the pair address consumed by the ensure modifier
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and mints supply to caller
owner state variable is compared against msg.sender in delegate
owner state variable is compared against msg.sender in batchSend
transferFrom reads and mutates the allowance mapping
transferFrom mutates balanceOf for sender and recipient
batchSend mutates balanceOf of msg.sender and recipients
approve writes into the allowance mapping
constructor sets totalSupply from _supply
transfer argument _to flows into the internal transferFrom call
transfer argument _value flows into the internal transferFrom call
_from of transferFrom is checked against owner and UNI in ensure
_to of transferFrom is credited in balanceOf[_to]
_value of transferFrom drives allowance and balance subtractions
_spender of approve becomes the allowance spender key
_value of approve is stored into allowance
parameter a of delegate is the target of the delegatecall
parameter b of delegate is the calldata passed to delegatecall
_tos array is iterated in batchSend to credit recipients
_value per recipient is multiplied by _tos.length
ensure compares _from against owner and the UNI pair
ensure compares _to against owner
loop counter i controls the batchSend iteration
loop local _to receives each recipient in batchSend
local total is checked against balanceOf[msg.sender] and subtracted
local UNI pair address is compared against _from in ensure
pairFor assigns the computed pair address to local pair
constructor parameter _name is stored into name
constructor parameter _symbol is stored into symbol
constructor parameter _supply is stored into totalSupply

normalization_plan.reason: parameter _to only exists within transfer and is consumed by its internal call
parameter _value only exists within transfer and is forwarded to transferFrom
parameter _from is only used inside transferFrom and its ensure modifier
parameter _to is only used inside transferFrom for balance crediting
parameter _value directly feeds the unchecked allowance and balance subtractions
parameter _spender is only used as the allowance key in approve
parameter _value is only stored by approve
parameter a is the direct target address of the delegatecall
parameter b is the direct calldata of the delegatecall
parameter _tos is only iterated by batchSend
parameter _value is an operand of the unchecked multiplication
parameter _from is only evaluated in the ensure modifier require
parameter _to is only evaluated in the ensure modifier require
local total holds the overflowing multiplication result
loop counter i is local to the batchSend loop
loop local _to is local to the batchSend loop
local UNI pair address is local to the ensure modifier
local pair is the return value computed inside pairFor
constructor parameter _name is only stored by the constructor
constructor parameter _symbol is only stored by the constructor
constructor parameter _supply is only stored by the constructor
